note: Hand-written corrections to one entity's name, kind, icon, blurb, or wikiUrl, for the rare case where Tier A or Tier B is simply wrong for that one ID and nobody upstream is going to fix it before the next build. Two kind entries exist as of 2026-08-31 for armor_stand and player. Icon overrides provide verified 16x16 sprite titles per Decisions 3 and 15 for advancements with missing or imprecise icons (Local Brewery, Hero of the Village, Voluntary Exile) and entities with oversized raw renders (Sculk, Sculk Shrieker, Zombie Horse Spawn Egg). See pipeline/normalize/curated.py for the loader and the shape each entry may carry.
